LanguageData.NightSafety_ProtectionOven.label: protection oven
LanguageData.NightSafety_ProtectionOven.description: A wood-fired oven whose warmth marks a circle of safety during the night.
LanguageData.NightSafety_HarassmentEffigy.label: harassment effigy
LanguageData.NightSafety_HarassmentEffigy.description: A crude marker left by night harassers. It serves no purpose beyond intimidation and obstruction.
LanguageData.NightSafety_Stemroot.label: stemroot
LanguageData.NightSafety_Stemroot.description: A mass of anomalous trees grown too dense to walk through. It blocks light and holds up a roof like a wall, and it knits itself back together after being cut into. Left alone it shifts slowly across the ground, closing old paths and opening new ones.
LanguageData.NightSafety_FilthSap.label: white sap
LanguageData.NightSafety_FilthSap.description: Thick pale sap wept out by bleeding stemroot. It dries slowly and washes off in the rain.
